message.content: {"thought": "The operator group analysis confirms: FFN dominates latency (133B ns, 64 occurrences, 99.99% compute time), attention dominates energy (49.8% memory energy), and the 'other' group (norm2, res2, res1) is memory/communication bound. The aggregate breakdown shows 67.6% compute time, 17.8% memory, 14.6% communication. Energy is 49.8% memory, 26.7% communication, 22.4% compute. The FFN compute-bound layers are already at max compute_units (16384). The memory/communication bottleneck on the critical path (norm2, res2, res1) suggests DRAM BW or NoP BW could be limiting. I should examine monetary cost to understand cost structure before proposing an expensive bandwidth increase.", "action": "tool", "tool": {"name": "summarize_monetary_cost", "arguments": {"top_components": 10}}}
